sloka: ज्ञात्वा तदामिषं विप्रो मानुषं भाजनं गतम् ।क्रोधेन महता ऽ ऽविष्टो व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.६५.२७ ॥
transliteration: jñātvā tadāmiṣaṁ vipro mānuṣaṁ bhājanaṁ gatam ।krodhena mahatā ' 'viṣṭo vyāhartumupacakrame ।। 7.65.27 ॥

translations.english: Realizing that the meat in the vessel was human flesh, the brahmin (Vasistha), overcome by great anger, began to speak (a curse).
